title: Heterogeneous Interface Physics & Darcian-Mean Reference
objective: Establish an independent, interface-consistent steady-Darcian reference for heterogeneous soil faces and use it to compare arithmetic, harmonic, LayeredMFP equal-flux and reconstructable SWKMEAN=7 Darcian-mean behaviour before any candidate solver face-law change.
reference_hierarchy: Independent steady local Darcy boundary-value solution with continuous pressure head and conservative flux across the material interface
Direct LayeredMFP equal-flux interface construction using SWAP-compatible K(h)
Simple arithmetic and harmonic endpoint-conductivity controls
Historical SWAP SWKMEAN=7 lineage only after its table-generation mathematics is reconstructed from source/literature or equivalent independent equations

source_provenance.observed_behaviour: Runtime mode 7 bilinearly interpolates a precomputed K_Szym(boundary, htop, hbot) table and validates profile, compartment count, material-layer mapping and dz against the table metadata.
literature_lineage: Warrick 1991 Numerical approximations of darcian flow through unsaturated soil
Szymkiewicz 2009 Approximation of internodal conductivities in numerical simulation of one-dimensional infiltration, drainage, and capillary rise in unsaturated soils
Szymkiewicz and Helmig 2011 Comparison of conductivity averaging methods for one-dimensional unsaturated flow in layered soils

qualification_questions: Can a numerically independent steady-Darcy BVP reproduce known homogeneous limiting cases without relying on any SWKMEAN implementation?
At heterogeneous interfaces, how close is LayeredMFP equal-flux to the independent BVP across gradients, grid lengths, orientations and conductivity contrasts?
Where do arithmetic and harmonic endpoint means fail relative to the steady-Darcian reference?
Does the LayeredMFP MFP construction remain conservative and directionally correct across strong contrasts?
Can the mathematical content behind SWKMEAN=7 be reconstructed independently despite missing .unf tables, without reverse-engineering undocumented binary values?
planned_outputs: qualification decision for the next transient-column workunit
